title: TDS on Professional Fees (194J)
shortAnswer: Calculate 10% TDS on consulting or professional fees.
longAnswer: Section 194J requires the payer to deduct TDS at 10% on fees for professional services, technical services, royalties, and non-compete fees. For technical services, the rate was reduced to 2% for payments made between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2021, and certain notifications apply; confirm the current rate for your payment type. The threshold is ₹30,000 per payee in a financial year. The TDS on Professional Fees Calculator takes the fee amount to show the TDS to deduct and the net payable. The payee claims the TDS as a credit in their return. Directors' remuneration and certain other payments have their own thresholds and rates. The calculator does not decide whether a payment is 'professional' under 194J or 'work' under 194C—that depends on the nature of the service. Confirm the rate and threshold on the e-filing portal before deducting.
